drafted_from: workflow:read-the-week-and-make-more-of-what-won row (input_schema, its monday wake and steps read-pieces onward) and its real first pause: tool:run-workflow-definition (runWorkflow in tools/write-a-job-done-in-several-steps-have/read-data/run-a-workflow.mjs) with the input below answers status paused, waiting on step read-pieces, which asks for pieces.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:read-the-week-and-make-more-of-what-won for my Instagram https://www.instagram.com/example.cook and my YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@examplecook, ranked by saves." It reads every piece you published this week, ranks each against your own median and hands back what won, why, and three 'more of this' briefs.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the published pieces the person already keeps as records, or their public profiles, and hands its ranking and briefs back in the run's answer.
instructions: 1. Write down each platform you publish on with the address of your own profile there, and the one number you rank pieces by (views, saves, sends or sign-ups).

2. Say "Run workflow:read-the-week-and-make-more-of-what-won" with platforms and measure. Step read-pieces reads your pieces from your records and your public profiles (yt-dlp for video, gallery-dl for images and carousels, your own browser for a signed-in page).
3. The next steps rank each piece of the week against your own median for its platform and kind, name the angle behind each one and write a 'more of this' brief for each of the top three.
4. Switch on its monday wake to have it run every Monday at 09:00 UTC; each Monday's answer can become a 'what worked this week' post or the next pieces themselves.
